integrity: Exact all-k proof and standalone finite checker (not an external certification); independently executable Python 3. Previously known tree-transposition facts are credited.
scientific_limitations: Only one-use fair switches on a simple cycle C_k, k>=3, with arbitrary public edge order; does not cover pendant switches, loops, repeated edges, biased switch bits, generic random-pair schedules, mixing times or cryptographic security. Priority not independently certified.
title: Exact hidden-bit entropy and cyclic-unimodality for one-pass fair switching on cycles
